answer: Require each new agent identity to complete a verifiable delay function before it can transact: a sequential puzzle that cannot be sped up by running many copies in parallel, like polishing a single quartz crystal by hand. The puzzle output seeds a pearl-like record of elapsed effort, and only after a violet-marked waiting period does the identity gain full weight. An attacker wanting a thousand sybils must therefore pay a thousand sequential delays, plus locked escrow per identity, while honest newcomers pay only one short wait.
